MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The locking-nut assortment feels useful alongside my hose clamps and electrical connectors because it supports the same practical repair work.",
    "The outdoor fastening tape fits my past interest in tapes and adhesives while offering removable attachment for projects."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The power-tool switch and fuel cans require specific equipment or storage needs that my repair purchases do not establish.",
    "Ten tubes of glue, twelve wastebaskets, and a thousand gloves are commitments I cannot justify from a current need; the glove size is also uncertain.",
    "The thermometer relates to inspection work, but I would wait for a temperature-measurement task, and the decorating kit does not match a project I currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop product, even when its purpose is quite different.",
    "My earlier bulk tape purchase seems to have been extended too broadly to large quantities of unrelated supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection is what an item helps me repair or fasten, rather than simply whether it belongs in a workshop.",
    "An item can fit my interests without being something I need now; project timing, usable quantity, and fit still determine whether I choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into specialized equipment and bulk supplies without enough evidence of a current need."
}
